purpose: Define privacy-aware log field redaction, classification and retention independently from source-data deletion or declassification.

topics.name: Log Redaction and Retention
topics.purpose: Define privacy-aware log field redaction, classification and retention independently from source-data deletion or declassification.

semantics.redaction_rule: Secrets/sensitive values are omitted, masked or redacted according to explicit profiles.
semantics.classification_rule: Logs may inherit classification from source/context.
semantics.source_rule: Deleting a log record never deletes referenced source data.
semantics.declassification_rule: Redaction does not automatically declassify underlying source.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.

references.purpose: Secret values must not leak into logs.

prose.summary: Define privacy-aware log field redaction, classification and retention independently from source-data deletion or declassification.
